title: Tencent CodeBuddy Fully Supports the Official Release of DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Significantly Enhancing Agent Capabilities
excerpt: CodeBuddy announces full support for the official version of DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and all WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy IDE, plugins, and CLI products have been adapted. T
content_html:
CodeBuddy announces full support for the official version of DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and all WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy IDE, plugins, and CLI products have been adapted. The new model further enhances AI Agent capabilities, significantly outperforming the previous version DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview in relevant benchmark tests, providing developers with a more efficient intelligent programming experience.

According to the introduction, the official version of DeepSeek-V4-Flash is optimized for code generation, task execution, and complex development processes, enabling deeper adaptation to different types of software development scenarios. Combined with the IDE, plugin, and command-line tool capabilities provided by CodeBuddy, developers can receive more intelligent assistance in code writing, debugging, project management, and other stages.

This integration further expands the application scope of domestic large models in the development tool ecosystem. As AI Agents evolve from code completion to complete task execution, the model's reasoning ability, tool calling capability, and complex project handling capability are becoming key factors in the competition for intelligent programming tools.

Currently, users can experience the AI development capabilities based on the official version of DeepSeek-V4-Flash through WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy product series, further improving code development efficiency and automation level.

content_html_zh:
CodeBuddy宣布全面支持DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版，所有WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy IDE、插件、CLI产品均已适配。 新模型进一步增强了AI Agent能力，在相关基准测试中显着优于之前版本DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview，为开发者提供更高效的智能编程体验。

据介绍，DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版针对代码生成、任务执行、复杂开发流程进行了优化，能够更深入地适配不同类型的软件开发场景。 结合CodeBuddy提供的IDE、插件、命令行工具能力，开发者可以在代码编写、调试、项目管理等阶段得到更智能的帮助。

此次整合进一步拓展了国产大模型在开发工具生态中的应用范围。 随着AI Agent从代码完成向完成任务执行演进，模型的推理能力、工具调用能力、复杂项目处理能力正在成为智能编程工具竞争的关键因素。

目前，用户可以通过WorkBuddy和CodeBuddy产品系列体验基于DeepSeek-V4-Flash正式版的AI开发能力，进一步提升代码开发效率和自动化水平。
